summary: Iteration 25 — Shopping Intelligence (Premium-only) + Packing copy removal validated end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases passed (POST /api/insights/shopping-intelligence returns 200 with recommendations for reviewer/premium; returns 402 for guest; /me flags premium correctly for reviewer and false for guest). Frontend (Expo web, mobile viewport 390x844): PREMIUM reviewer path — Wardrobe tab renders shopping-intelligence-entry banner (with chevron icon), tap opens /shop, analyse-wardrobe button triggers gap analysis and renders testID gap-result containing piece name, category, priority pill, 'why' rationale, '~N new outfits it could unlock' stat, and 'Works with what you own' pairs_with chips referencing owned items. The 'Check a specific item' shop-upload-button section still renders below the gap block. GUEST/FREE path — banner shows lock icon; tap routes to /premium. Direct visit to /shop shows analyse button as 'Unlock with Premium' (lock icon); tapping it routes to /premium (backend also enforces 402). Paywall feature list on /premium contains 'Shopping Intelligence (skip duplicates)' and NO LONGER contains 'Packing Assistant'. Grep of /app/frontend/app confirms 'Packing Assistant' string is fully removed from user-facing copy while the dormant /packing screen remains. No red-screen, no blocking console errors on Wardrobe, /shop, or /premium.
critical_code_review_comments: shop.tsx line 361: style key 'simPlaceholder' defined but never referenced — minor dead style, safe to remove.
premium.tsx line 34: 'setRestoring(true);' is placed on the same line as the arrow function opener '=> {' — cosmetic formatting only, no functional impact.
shop.tsx correctly guards analyseWardrobe with client-side premium check AND handles server 402 by routing to /premium — good defense in depth.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing reviewer account (review@aureve.app) which is auto-seeded with 16-item demo wardrobe on backend startup, and POST /api/auth/guest which mints a fresh guest with the same 16-item demo wardrobe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: shopping-intelligence-entry lives on the Wardrobe tab only when laundryMode is off (hidden when laundry filter active). The /shop route is under (tabs) group with href:null so it is NOT in the bottom tab bar — always navigate via the Wardrobe banner or direct URL /shop. Reviewer login (email/password) skips onboarding correctly. AI response for gap analysis takes ~8-12s so allow ~30s polling with 2s intervals. Guest gets same 16-item demo wardrobe so both premium and free paths have enough data (>=3 items) to satisfy the /api/insights/shopping-intelligence min-item precondition — the guest is blocked at enforce_limit('shop') with HTTP 402 before item count is even checked.
